summary: Implemented the phase-1 evidence record, stable workload signature, legal-plan enumeration/static filters, exact-match quality-gated resolver, explicit-flag precedence, startup integration, selection diagnostics, and world-size-one plan mapping. Existing singleton group fast paths were verified as related prerequisite work.

tests.what_was_measured: 210 tests and 67 subtests: report round-trip/hash integrity, legal product/head/sequence/memory/CFG filtering, exact signature selection, batch/step/model/topology mismatch rejection, stale-code API rejection, quality gate exclusion, explicit flag precedence, singleton plan application, server argument regressions, and singleton device-backend avoidance. Raw output: reports/j-70a2a746c1d2/pytest.log

gpu_execution_evidence: One assigned AMD Instinct MI355X (gfx950) was visible. No model weights or qualifying diffusion calibration fixture were provided, and the changed code performs control-plane schema/resolution rather than GPU numerical computation, so no unrelated GPU smoke is claimed.
remaining_limitations: No model-specific end-to-end calibration artifact was produced: model weights, accuracy/trajectory gate, and a multi-GPU topology were unavailable. The requested batch 1/larger batch, CFG serial/parallel, TP 1/2/4, long-latent SP, and cache/compile benchmark matrix remains unverified.

The implementation consumes evidence produced by calibration but does not yet provide a generic isolated launcher capable of running every diffusion pipeline and collecting stage timings or collective instrumentation.
Startup exposes the selected plan, source, rejected reasons, and signature digest through the resolution object and logs; dedicated metrics export is not implemented.

Code-revision fail-closed behavior is available to callers of resolve_calibrated_plan, but startup cannot reliably identify a source commit from an installed package and therefore does not enforce it automatically.
Routing among separately launched pools is outside this contribution; startup resolution only is implemented.

Existing world-size-one fast paths avoid device communicators and short-circuit collectives, but process-group state required by the current server protocol is retained. No model-specific assertion that every FSDP wrapper is absent was possible without model weights.
